# Third-party licenses

Termlet is distributed under Apache-2.0 (see [LICENSE](LICENSE)). It
builds on third-party open-source software, embeds two fonts, and builds
dependencies from five patched forks. This file lists every component and
reproduces the license texts required for redistribution.

It is generated from the resolved Cargo dependency graph by
`tools/licenses/gen_third_party_licenses.py`. Regenerate it after dependency
changes with:

```bash
cargo fetch
python3 tools/licenses/gen_third_party_licenses.py
```

## Bundled components

These are redistributed directly in this repository or compiled into the
binary, beyond the ordinary crate dependencies listed below.

| Component | Version | License | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Source Code Pro | 2.042 | SIL OFL-1.1 | Embedded terminal font. Full text in `fonts/licenses/SourceCodePro-OFL-1.1.txt`. |
| Lucide | — | ISC | Icon glyphs embedded via the `lucide-icons` crate. Notice in `fonts/licenses/Lucide-ISC.txt`. |
| Font Awesome Free | 7.2.0 | CC BY 4.0 (icons) | Platform/OS glyphs in `assets/icon-font/` (debian, ubuntu, centos, linux, windows, macos), compiled into the `my-icons` font. See <https://fontawesome.com/license/free>. |

The patched `iced` family, `alacritty_terminal`, `vte`, `iced_term`, and `iced_drop`
crates are built from forks pinned to exact commits in the
[`Cargo.toml` patch table](Cargo.toml); they are listed below in the
dependency table under their fork sources.

The `my-icons` font under `fonts/icons/` is generated from `assets/icon-font/`,
which mixes Font Awesome Free glyphs (see above) with project-authored
ones. The application UI bundles no typeface and renders with the platform
default sans-serif.
